description: This PHP class 'Escher' is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library and is responsible for parsing and reading Escher records within an XLS file, particularly for handling drawing and shape-related data. It includes methods for loading Escher streams, reading various record types, and constructing internal objects representing drawing data.

classes.name: Escher
classes.description: A class for parsing and handling Escher records in Excel XLS files, facilitating the extraction of drawing and shape data within the spreadsheet.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and parses an Escher stream data, returning the constructed drawing object.

methods.name: readDefault
methods.description: Reads a generic or unknown record within the Escher data stream.

methods.name: readDggContainer
methods.description: Reads a Drawing Group Container record, a container for multiple drawings.

methods.name: readDgg
methods.description: Reads an individual Drawing Group record.

methods.name: readBstoreContainer
methods.description: Reads a Blip Store Container, which contains embedded images like JPEG or PNG.

methods.name: readBSE
methods.description: Reads a BSE (Blip Store Entry) record, representing image info.

methods.name: readBlipJPEG
methods.description: Reads a JPEG image data record.

methods.name: readBlipPNG
methods.description: Reads a PNG image data record.

methods.name: readOPT
methods.description: Reads an OfficeArt OPT (OfficeArt Property) record.

methods.name: readTertiaryOPT
methods.description: Reads a TertiaryOPT record, a specific OfficeArt property set.

methods.name: readSplitMenuColors
methods.description: Reads a SplitMenuColors record.

methods.name: readDgContainer
methods.description: Reads a Drawing Container record, which groups multiple drawings.

methods.name: readDg
methods.description: Reads an individual Drawing record.

methods.name: readSpgrContainer
methods.description: Reads a Shape Group Container record.

methods.name: readSpContainer
methods.description: Reads a Shape Container record.

methods.name: readSpgr
methods.description: Reads a Shape Group record.

methods.name: readSp
methods.description: Reads a Shape record.

methods.name: readClientTextbox
methods.description: Reads a ClientTextbox shape record.

methods.name: readClientAnchor
methods.description: Reads a ClientAnchor record, which holds shape positioning info.

methods.name: readClientData
methods.description: Reads a ClientData record.

methods.name: applyAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to invoke setter methods on the referenced object.

methods.name: readOfficeArtRGFOPTE
methods.description: Reads OfficeArt property-value pairs.
